purpose: portfolio accounting and risk integrity only; factor semantics frozen; not a return improvement
unchanged_from_v1: MOM12_2 and LOWVOL252 definitions and ranking (V1 module function reused, imported unchanged)
USD 10,000, N = 20, 5% target, whole shares, fractional forbidden
monthly calendar: signal = last session of month, fill = next session close
entry top 10%, hold top 20%, whole-share skip -> next rank
sizing on signal close; sells before buys; proceeds usable same session
40 bp one-way primary, 0/20/30 bp diagnostics, SEC 0.206 bp + FINRA TAF on sells
benchmarks SPY, RSP, MTUM, USMV; price return
no factor combination, no regime filter, no sector filter or cap

ticker_continuity.identity: issuer continuity (CIK) has priority over ticker for an open position
ticker_continuity.cik_source: union of all CS snapshots (ticker -> cik); old and new ticker must map to the same CIK
transition_if_all: old ticker has a last valid close L_old inside the price window and no close after it
new ticker first valid close F_new > L_old
sessions strictly between L_old and F_new <= 5
new ticker has no close on or before L_old (not a concurrent share class)
exactly one candidate new ticker satisfies the above (otherwise AMBIGUOUS -> treated as delisting, flagged)
ticker_continuity.position_carry: shares carried 1:1 to the new ticker at F_new; split records of the new ticker apply as usual; value = shares x new close
ticker_continuity.price_gap_ratio: first new close / last old close is reported as a diagnostic, not a condition
ticker_continuity.ranking: unchanged: the new ticker is ranked under V1 rules (its own price history); if it has no valid feature it is outside the hold zone and is sold at the next execution
ticker_continuity.true_delisting: price stop with no qualifying transition: V1 rule (value at last close, sold at it at the next execution, flagged)
ticker_continuity.regression_fixture: BREA -> SLMT: CIK 0001939965, L_old 2025-10-02, F_new 2025-10-03, must be detected and the MOM position carried

drift_band.weight_basis: position value / NAV at the signal close (pre-trade), same basis as sizing
drift_band.above_upper: sell down to max(1, target_shares) shares (never below one share)
drift_band.below_lower_and_hold_eligible: buy up to target_shares (cash permitting, decrement while cash short; partial allowed, flagged cash-limited)
drift_band.new_entry: target_shares (V1); if cash shortfall would leave the new position below 2.5% of NAV_signal it is not opened (cash-constrained stop) [band applied to entries, added at freeze]
drift_band.no_signal_or_exec_price: no band trade for that name, flagged
drift_band.order: exits, trims (sells) -> top-ups in rank order -> new entries in rank order
drift_band.costs: band trades pay the same 40 bp + SEC + TAF; included in turnover and cost

dust: no dollar threshold; handled by hold zone and band only
measurements_after_each_execution: effective N = 1 / sum(w_i^2) with w_i = value_i / NAV (reported) and with w_i normalized to invested value (gated)
max and min weight (signal basis and execution-close basis)
band trims, band top-ups, cash-limited top-ups

runs.V1C: V1 weights rule + ticker continuity (isolates the accounting fix)
runs.V2: ticker continuity + drift band (canonical from V2 on)

integrity_gates.I1_transition_fixture: BREA -> SLMT detected with the fixture dates and the V2 MOM position carried to SLMT
integrity_gates.I2_separation: every held price stop is classified TRANSITION or DELISTING (or AMBIGUOUS, flagged); no TRANSITION valued at a stale last close after F_new
integrity_gates.I3_max_weight: after every execution, signal-basis weight <= 7.5% for every position, except a single-share position (whole-share tolerance)
integrity_gates.I4_no_pathological_dust: no position below 2.5% signal-basis weight after two consecutive executions
integrity_gates.I5_effective_N: V2 minimum invested-normalized effective N across executions > V1C minimum, for each factor
integrity_gates.I6_accounting: final cash reconciles to the trade log within $0.01, and recomputed costs from the trade log match within $0.01
integrity_gates.I7_determinism: two runs produce identical trade-log sha256
integrity_gates.I8_ranking_unchanged: V1 contract and V1 census script sha256 verified at start; ranking function is the V1 module object
integrity_gates.PASS: PORTFOLIO_INTEGRITY_PASS iff I1..I8 pass for both factors

attribution: MOM vs MTUM and LOWVOL vs USMV: universe, weighting, rebalance, turnover, concentration, sector, cash drag, whole-share; holdings market cap from dei shares outstanding x close; ETF methodology from official MSCI/iShares pages
